related_questions.question: How long can the IRS collect on a tax lien?
related_questions.snippet: The IRS generally has 10 years – from the date your tax was assessed – to collect the tax and any associated penalties and interest from you. This time period is called the Collection Statute Expiration Date (CSED). Your account can include multiple tax assessments, each with their own CSED.

related_questions.snippet: How much will the IRS usually settle for? The IRS will usually settle for what it deems you can feasibly pay.
